manual_steps.deploy_app: Submit the study APK using the current Huawei platform installation UI; save the task identity and final installed-app evidence.
manual_steps.connect_debug: Record only debugging capabilities observed in this session. If ADB is available, set remote_adb=true and the verified serial; otherwise set false. This template does not establish or refresh credentials.
manual_steps.end_session: Release the device through the platform and record the observed confirmation time with its timezone and supporting evidence.
manual_steps.reacquire_device: If needed, verify the device identity after reacquisition; a matching model alone is insufficient.
manual_steps.prepare_device_probe: Determine whether Shizuku and accessibility can be enabled on the selected device. The template does not assert that either capability is available.
